_note: Each min_mm is the page's own number, quoted beside it as read on that day. Where the page gives a recommended and an absolute minimum, the absolute minimum is used: this is the fab's floor, not good practice. Standard FR-4 service only; the page's cost-adder options (0.1 mm drills on boards 1 mm thick or less) are not assumed. Board size, soldermask web and BGA pads are not checked: KiCad has no constraint for the first, and the other two depend on the finish and mask colour ordered.
